note: d_min=0.08 — late-time tail (months 60+) declines from ~275 to ~210 over 2 years, flatter than exponential. Marginal improvement, d_min alone insufficient to fix the large MAPE — the real problem is likely the 2024 workover bump and 2020 curtailment distorting the fit.

significance_threshold=0.30 — detected phase break reduced fit_months from 90 to 59, in-sample R² dropped to 0.46. Phase detection hurt because it cut training data too much. The 2020 dip is not a true regime change.
outlier_threshold=0.20 — no effect, outlier_rejection_rate still 0%. The outlier_window=3 is too narrow to detect the 2020 curtailment as outliers. Need wider window.
outlier_window=7 + outlier_threshold=0.20 — still 0% rejection. Outlier detection method does not flag 2020 curtailment. Abandoning outlier approach.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 — no effect, optimizer converges to same solution (qi=871, di=0.37, b=1.59) regardless of initial qi guess.
di_initial=0.80 — no effect, optimizer converges to same local minimum regardless of initial guess. Need to change bounds/constraints, not initial guesses.
b_initial=1.20 — no effect. Optimizer is very robust to initial conditions, always converges to same (qi=871, di=0.37, b=1.59). Need to change bounds not guesses.
di_upper_bound=2.0 — no effect. Fitted di=0.37 is already well below even 2.0. The bound is not active.

smoothing_window=5 — dampened monthly volatility, R²_insample improved 0.889→0.945, fit_months 90→96. First real improvement. Smoothing helps because this well has significant month-to-month scatter throughout.
smoothing_window=6 — oversmoothing, fit_months dropped to 88, R²_insample 0.945→0.864. Window=5 is the sweet spot.
d_min=0.10 — too aggressive, forecast declines too fast. R²_outsample worsened to -0.37. d_min=0.08 was already near optimal.

d_min=0.06 — flatter terminal decline improved R²_outsample from -0.253 to -0.240. Counter-intuitive: lower d_min works better because the holdout includes rebound months (Sep-Dec 2024 ~256-283 bbl) before shut-in, so a flatter forecast is less wrong on average.
